words.gloss: of the chiefs of infantry, cavalry, chariots and elephants
with the confidence of a friend

hindi: राजा के और राजा के प्रिय जनों के निकट रहने वाले गुप्तचर पैदल, घुड़सवार, रथ और हाथी सेना के प्रमुखों में से जो उनके मित्र-स्थान में हों, उनसे मित्र के विश्वास के साथ कहें कि "राजा क्रुद्ध है"।
english: Secret agents close to the king and to the king's favourites should tell, with the confidence of a friend, those among the chiefs of the infantry, cavalry, chariots and elephants who stand in the position of friends to them: "The king is angry."
notes: patty-aśva-ratha-dvipa-mukhyānām is a partitive genitive with mitra-sthānīyeṣu: those chiefs who are on friendly terms with the agents (12.3.4 'what we told you' shows the chiefs themselves were told). That the king is angry at them is implied, not stated.
lines_deva: राज्ञो राज.वल्लभानां च-आसन्नाः सत्त्रिणः पत्त्य्.अश्व.रथ.द्विप.मुख्यानां "राजा क्रुद्धः" इति सुहृद्.विश्वासेन मित्र.स्थानीयेषु कथयेयुः
lines_iast: rājño rāja.vallabhānāṃ ca-āsannāḥ sattriṇaḥ patty.aśva.ratha.dvipa.mukhyānāṃ "rājā kruddhaḥ" iti suhṛd.viśvāsena mitra.sthānīyeṣu kathayeyuḥ

words.gloss: having made counter-measures against the night patrol

hindi: जब यह बात फैल जाए, तब रात्रि के पहरे का प्रतीकार कर चुके तीक्ष्ण उनके घरों में कहें कि "स्वामी के वचन से आइए"।
english: When this has become widespread, the assassins, having made counter-measures against the night patrol, should say in their houses: "By the master's word, come."
notes: kṛta-rātri-cāra-pratīkārāḥ: rātri-cāra taken as the night watch/patrol; an alternative is 'night movement' of the victims. gṛheṣu refers to the houses of the chiefs. tīkṣṇa = assassin, the 'fierce' class of secret agent (glossary).
lines_deva: बहुली.भूते तीक्ष्णाः कृत.रात्रि.चार.प्रतीकारा गृहेषु "स्वामि.वचनेन-आगम्यताम्" इति ब्रूयुः
lines_iast: bahulī.bhūte tīkṣṇāḥ kṛta.rātri.cāra.pratīkārā gṛheṣu "svāmi.vacanena-āgamyatām" iti brūyuḥ

words.gram: pres. part. nis-√gam, m. acc. pl.

hindi: वे उन्हें बाहर निकलते ही मार डालें, और पास खड़े लोगों से कहें कि "यह स्वामी का सन्देश है"।
english: They should strike them down just as they are coming out, and should say to those nearby: "It is the master's message."
lines_deva: तान्निर्गच्छत एव-अभिहन्युः, "स्वामि.सन्देशः" इति च-आसन्नान् ब्रूयुः
lines_iast: tānnirgacchata eva-abhihanyuḥ, "svāmi.sandeśaḥ" iti ca-āsannān brūyuḥ

words.gram: ppp caus. pra-√vas with a-, m. nom. pl.

words.gloss: by one who wishes to live

hindi: और जो मारे नहीं गए हैं, उनसे गुप्तचर कहें कि "यह वही है जो हमने कहा था; जीने की इच्छा रखने वाले को भाग जाना चाहिए"।
english: And to those who have not been done away with, the secret agents should say: "This is what we told you; one who wishes to live must get away."
notes: apravāsita: pravāsayati in this text means to put to death (lit. send away); rendered 'done away with'. The sense 'not sent away/banished' is the literal alternative.
lines_deva: ये च-अप्रवासितास् तान् सत्त्रिणो ब्रूयुः "एतत् तद् यद् अस्माभिः कथितम्, जीवितु.कामेन-अपक्रान्तव्यम्" इति
lines_iast: ye ca-apravāsitās tān sattriṇo brūyuḥ "etat tad yad asmābhiḥ kathitam, jīvitu.kāmena-apakrāntavyam" iti

words.gloss: the regent (guardian of the empty capital)
not fit to be asked for
words.gram: ger. adj. √yāc with a-, m. acc. sg.

hindi: और जिनके माँगने पर राजा नहीं देता, उनसे गुप्तचर कहें कि "शून्यपाल से राजा ने कहा है: 'अमुक और अमुक मुझसे न माँगने योग्य वस्तु माँगते हैं; मैंने उन्हें अस्वीकार कर दिया है; वे शत्रु से मिले हुए हैं; उन्हें उखाड़ फेंकने का प्रयत्न करो'"।
english: And to those to whom the king, when asked, does not give, the secret agents should say: "The regent has been told by the king: 'So-and-so and so-and-so ask me for a thing not fit to be asked; I have refused them; they are in league with the enemy; strive to remove them.'"
notes: The token '-' is the edition's dash before the quotation. śūnya-pāla: the officer left in charge of the capital when the king is away. mā = mām (enclitic). yācate is singular, distributive after 'asau ca asau ca'.
lines_deva: येभ्यश् च राजा याचितो न ददाति तान् सत्त्रिणो ब्रूयुः - "उक्तः शून्य.पालो राज्ञा "अयाच्यम् अर्थम् असौ च-असौ च मा याचते, मया प्रत्याख्याताः शत्रु.संहिताः, तेषाम् उद्धरणे प्रयतस्व" इति
lines_iast: yebhyaś ca rājā yācito na dadāti tān sattriṇo brūyuḥ - "uktaḥ śūnya.pālo rājñā "ayācyam artham asau ca-asau ca mā yācate, mayā pratyākhyātāḥ śatru.saṃhitāḥ, teṣām uddharaṇe prayatasva" iti

hindi: फिर पहले की तरह आचरण करे।
english: Then he should act as before.
notes: 'As before' refers to the procedure of 12.3.2-3 (assassins summon and kill).
lines_deva: ततः पूर्ववद् आचरेत्
lines_iast: tataḥ pūrvavad ācaret

words.gloss: the regent (guardian of the empty capital)
not fit to be asked for
words.gram: ger. adj. √yāc with a-, m. acc. sg.

hindi: और जिनके माँगने पर राजा देता है, उनसे गुप्तचर कहें कि "शून्यपाल से राजा ने कहा है: 'अमुक और अमुक मुझसे न माँगने योग्य वस्तु माँगते हैं; वह वस्तु मैंने उन्हें विश्वास दिलाने के लिए दी है; वे शत्रु से मिले हुए हैं; उन्हें उखाड़ फेंकने का प्रयत्न करो'"।
english: And to those to whom the king, when asked, gives, the secret agents should say: "The regent has been told by the king: 'So-and-so and so-and-so ask me for a thing not fit to be asked; that thing has been given to them by me to win their confidence; they are in league with the enemy; strive to remove them.'"
notes: The token '-' is the edition's dash before the quotation.
lines_deva: येभ्यश् च राजा याचितो ददाति तान् सत्त्रिणो ब्रूयुः - "उक्तः शून्य.पालो राज्ञा "अयाच्यम् अर्थम् असौ च-असौ च मा याचते, तेभ्यो मया सो ऽर्थो विश्वास.अर्थं दत्तः, शत्रु.संहिताः, तेषाम् उद्धरणे प्रयतस्व" इति
lines_iast: yebhyaś ca rājā yācito dadāti tān sattriṇo brūyuḥ - "uktaḥ śūnya.pālo rājñā "ayācyam artham asau ca-asau ca mā yācate, tebhyo mayā so 'rtho viśvāsa.arthaṃ dattaḥ, śatru.saṃhitāḥ, teṣām uddharaṇe prayatasva" iti

hindi: फिर पहले की तरह आचरण करे।
english: Then he should act as before.
lines_deva: ततः पूर्ववद् आचरेत्
lines_iast: tataḥ pūrvavad ācaret

words.gloss: the regent (guardian of the empty capital)
than because of being suspicious on account of their own guilt

hindi: और जो उससे माँगने योग्य वस्तु नहीं माँगते, उनसे गुप्तचर कहें कि "शून्यपाल से राजा ने कहा है: 'अमुक और अमुक मुझसे माँगने योग्य वस्तु नहीं माँगते; अपने दोष की शंका के कारण नहीं तो और क्या? उन्हें उखाड़ फेंकने का प्रयत्न करो'"।
english: And to those who do not ask him for a thing fit to be asked, the secret agents should say: "The regent has been told by the king: 'So-and-so and so-and-so do not ask me for a thing fit to be asked; what else can it be but from fear of their own guilt? Strive to remove them.'"
notes: The token '-' is the edition's dash before the quotation. kim anyat ... -tvāt: 'what else (is the reason) than ...'.
lines_deva: ये च-एनं याच्यम् अर्थं न याचन्ते तान् सत्त्रिणो ब्रूयुः - "उक्तः शून्य.पालो राज्ञा "याच्यम् अर्थम् असौ च-असौ च मा न याचते, किम् अन्यत् स्व.दोष.शङ्कितत्वात्, तेषाम् उद्धरणे प्रयतस्व" इति
lines_iast: ye ca-enaṃ yācyam arthaṃ na yācante tān sattriṇo brūyuḥ - "uktaḥ śūnya.pālo rājñā "yācyam artham asau ca-asau ca mā na yācate, kim anyat sva.doṣa.śaṅkitatvāt, teṣām uddharaṇe prayatasva" iti

hindi: फिर पहले की तरह आचरण करे।
english: Then he should act as before.
lines_deva: ततः पूर्ववद् आचरेत्
lines_iast: tataḥ pūrvavad ācaret

hindi: इससे सम्पूर्ण कृत्य-पक्ष समझा दिया गया।
english: By this the whole party of the seducible is explained.
notes: kṛtya-pakṣa = the party of the seducible, persons who can be won over (the four kinds of 1.14); '(the treatment of)' the party is understood, not in the text.
lines_deva: एतेन सर्वः कृत्य.पक्षो व्याख्यातः
lines_iast: etena sarvaḥ kṛtya.pakṣo vyākhyātaḥ

words.gloss: one who is close (to the king)

hindi: अथवा राजा के निकट रहने वाला गुप्तचर राजा को यह विश्वास दिलाए कि "आपका अमुक और अमुक महामात्र शत्रु के पुरुषों से बातचीत करता है"।
english: Or a secret agent close to the king should make the king believe: "This and this high officer of yours is conversing with the enemy's men."
lines_deva: प्रत्यासन्नो वा राजानं सत्त्री ग्राहयेत् "असौ च-असौ च ते महा.मात्रः शत्रु.पुरुषैः सम्भाषते" इति
lines_iast: pratyāsanno vā rājānaṃ sattrī grāhayet "asau ca-asau ca te mahā.mātraḥ śatru.puruṣaiḥ sambhāṣate" iti

hindi: जब राजा यह मान ले, तब उसे दूष्य लोगों को उसके पत्र ले जाते हुए दिखाए कि "यह वही है"।
english: When the king has accepted it, he should show him treasonable men carrying his written messages, saying: "This is it."
notes: asya taken as the accused officer (the messages purport to be his); it could also be read as the king's. dūṣya = the treasonable (glossary).
lines_deva: प्रतिपन्ने दूष्यान् अस्य शासन.हरान् दर्शयेत् "एतत् तत्" इति
lines_iast: pratipanne dūṣyān asya śāsana.harān darśayet "etat tat" iti

words.gloss: army chiefs and men of the constituent elements
words.gram: m. acc. pl., dvandva of tat-puruṣas

hindi: अथवा सेना के प्रमुखों और प्रकृतियों के पुरुषों को भूमि या सुवर्ण का लोभ देकर उनसे अपने ही लोगों पर आक्रमण कराए या उन्हें वहाँ से हटा ले।
english: Or, having tempted the army chiefs and the men of the constituent elements with land or gold, he should make them attack their own people or draw them away.
notes: prakṛti-puruṣa: leading men of the (enemy's) constituent elements (prakṛti = constituent element, glossary). apavāhayet: 'cause to desert / carry away'.
lines_deva: सेना.मुख्य.प्रकृति.पुरुषान् वा भूम्या हिरण्येन वा लोभयित्वा स्वेषु विक्रमयेद् अपवाहयेद् वा
lines_iast: senā.mukhya.prakṛti.puruṣān vā bhūmyā hiraṇyena vā lobhayitvā sveṣu vikramayed apavāhayed vā

hindi: उसका जो पुत्र निकट या किसी दुर्ग में रहता हो, उसे गुप्तचर के द्वारा भड़काए कि "तुम गुणों में बढ़कर पुत्र हो, फिर भी छिपाकर रखे गए हो; तो क्यों उपेक्षा करते हो? आक्रमण करके ले लो, इससे पहले कि युवराज तुम्हें नष्ट कर दे"।
english: The son of his who lives nearby or in a fort, him he should have instigated through a secret agent: "You are the son better endowed in qualities, yet you are kept in the background; why then do you stay indifferent? Attack and seize it, before the heir-apparent destroys you."
notes: purā with present vināśayati has future sense ('before he destroys'). The object of gṛhāṇa (the kingdom) is understood. antar-hita: lit. 'placed within/hidden', i.e. kept out of the succession.
lines_deva: यो ऽस्य पुत्रः समीपे दुर्गे वा प्रतिवसति तं सत्त्रिणा-उपजापयेत् "आत्म.सम्पन्नतरस् त्वं पुत्रः, तथा-अप्य् अन्तर्.हितः, तत्.किम् उपेक्षसे विक्रम्य गृहाण, पुरा त्वा युव.राजो विनाशयति" इति
lines_iast: yo 'sya putraḥ samīpe durge vā prativasati taṃ sattriṇā-upajāpayet "ātma.sampannataras tvaṃ putraḥ, tathā-apy antar.hitaḥ, tat.kim upekṣase vikramya gṛhāṇa, purā tvā yuva.rājo vināśayati" iti

hindi: अथवा उसके कुल के किसी व्यक्ति या अपरुद्ध को सुवर्ण का लोभ देकर कहे कि "उसकी भीतरी सेना, सीमान्त की सैन्य-टुकड़ी या सीमा-प्रदेश को कुचल दो"।
english: Or, having tempted with gold a member of his family or a prince in disfavour, he should say: "Crush his inner army, his frontier contingent, or his border region."
notes: aparuddha: a prince kept confined or in disfavour (as in 1.18). antar-bala: the army in the interior, as against the frontier contingent (pratyanta-skandha).
lines_deva: तत्.कुलीनम् अपरुद्धं वा हिरण्येन प्रतिलोभ्य ब्रूयात् "अन्तर्.बलं प्रत्यन्त.स्कन्धम् अन्तं वा-अस्य प्रमृद्नीहि" इति
lines_iast: tat.kulīnam aparuddhaṃ vā hiraṇyena pratilobhya brūyāt "antar.balaṃ pratyanta.skandham antaṃ vā-asya pramṛdnīhi" iti

hindi: आटविकों को धन और सम्मान से अपने पक्ष में करके उसके राज्य को नष्ट करवाए।
english: Having won over the forest chieftains with wealth and honour, he should have his kingdom ravaged.
lines_deva: आटविकान् अर्थ.मानाभ्याम् उपगृह्य राज्यम् अस्य घातयेत्
lines_iast: āṭavikān artha.mānābhyām upagṛhya rājyam asya ghātayet

words.gloss: of him when he has turned back

hindi: अथवा उसके पार्ष्णिग्राह से कहे कि "यह राजा निश्चय ही मुझे उखाड़कर तुम्हें उखाड़ेगा; इसकी पार्ष्णि पकड़ो; जब वह तुम्हारी ओर मुड़ जाए, तब मैं इसकी पार्ष्णि पकड़ूँगा"।
english: Or he should say to his heel-seizer: "This king, indeed, having destroyed me, will destroy you; seize his heel; when he has turned back against you, I shall seize his heel."
notes: 'Seize the heel' = attack in the rear. tvayi nivṛttasya: genitive with pārṣṇim, 'of him turned back against you'.
lines_deva: पार्ष्णि.ग्राहं वा-अस्य ब्रूयात् "एष खलु राजा माम् उच्छिद्य त्वाम् उच्छेत्स्यति, पार्ष्णिम् अस्य गृहाण, त्वयि निवृत्तस्य-अहं पार्ष्णिं ग्रहीष्यामि" इति
lines_iast: pārṣṇi.grāhaṃ vā-asya brūyāt "eṣa khalu rājā mām ucchidya tvām ucchetsyati, pārṣṇim asya gṛhāṇa, tvayi nivṛttasya-ahaṃ pārṣṇiṃ grahīṣyāmi" iti

hindi: अथवा उसके मित्रों से कहे कि "मैं तुम्हारा बाँध हूँ; मेरे टूट जाने पर यह राजा तुम सबको बहा ले जाएगा; अथवा हम मिलकर उसके अभियान को विफल कर दें"।
english: Or he should say to his allies: "I am your dam; when I am broken, this king will sweep you all away; or, joining together, let us wreck his expedition."
notes: setu 'dam/embankment' with the image of flooding (plāvayiṣyati). The second vā is read as 'or (rather)'.
lines_deva: मित्राणि वा-अस्य ब्रूयात् "अहं वः सेतुः, मयि विभिन्ने सर्वान् एष वो राजा प्लावयिष्यति, सम्भूय वा-अस्य यात्रां विहनाम" इति
lines_iast: mitrāṇi vā-asya brūyāt "ahaṃ vaḥ setuḥ, mayi vibhinne sarvān eṣa vo rājā plāvayiṣyati, sambhūya vā-asya yātrāṃ vihanāma" iti

words.gloss: to come to the aid of

hindi: जो उससे मिले हुए हैं और जो नहीं मिले हुए हैं, उनके पास सन्देश भेजे कि "यह राजा निश्चय ही मुझे उखाड़कर आप लोगों पर कार्रवाई करेगा; सावधान हो जाओ; आपके लिए मेरी सहायता करना ही अधिक श्रेयस्कर है"।
english: He should send word to those leagued with him and to those not leagued: "This king, indeed, having uprooted me, will act against you; be aware; it is better for you to come to my aid."
notes: ahaṃ vaḥ śreyān abhyupapattum: lit. 'I am the better one for you to support'; 'karma kariṣyati' = 'will do (his) work on you', i.e. act against you. The genitives depend on an understood 'to the kings'.
lines_deva: तत्.संहतानाम् असंहतानां च प्रेषयेत् "एष खलु राजा माम् उत्पाट्य भवत्सु कर्म करिष्यति, बुध्यध्वम्, अहं वः श्रेयान् अभ्युपपत्तुम्" इति
lines_iast: tat.saṃhatānām asaṃhatānāṃ ca preṣayet "eṣa khalu rājā mām utpāṭya bhavatsu karma kariṣyati, budhyadhvam, ahaṃ vaḥ śreyān abhyupapattum" iti

hindi: अथवा फिर मध्यम अथवा उदासीन राजा के पास, जो भी निकट हो, मुक्ति के लिए अपने सर्वस्व के साथ उसके प्रति समर्पण का सन्देश भेजे।
english: Or again he should send word to the middle king or to the neutral king, whichever is nearer, for the sake of his own release, surrendering to him with all his possessions.
notes: Verse (śloka): 16 syllables per line. The genitives madhyamasya/udāsīnasya are taken as the recipients of the message; tad-arpaṇam (offering of himself/that to him) is the object of prahiṇuyāt.
lines_deva: मध्यमस्य प्रहिणुयाद् उदासीनस्य वा पुनः
यथा-आसन्नस्य मोक्ष.अर्थं सर्व.स्वेन तद्.अर्पणम्
lines_iast: madhyamasya prahiṇuyād udāsīnasya vā punaḥ
yathā-āsannasya mokṣa.arthaṃ sarva.svena tad.arpaṇam
